title: Data Discovery and Reuse Practices in Research
descriptions: This dataset presents the results from a global survey designed to investigate how individuals involved in research discover and reuse secondary data. The data consist of 1677 complete responses received from individuals in 105 countries. The data are provided in two files: one for researchers and one for those working in research support. The README file provides extensive guidance on using the data files and the associated descriptions of the variables.
